reviews.title: Bro
reviews.text: This app is honestly a complete disappointment and feels like nothing more than a cash grab disguised as a useful tool. You download it expecting basic features to actually work, only to be immediately hit with a subscription wall that blocks almost everything. It’s ridiculous that even the simplest functions require payment, making the free version practically useless. The app advertises itself as helpful and accessible, but in reality, it locks all meaningful features behind an overpriced subscription that isn’t worth it at all. There are constant prompts pushing you to upgrade, which gets annoying fast and ruins the entire user experience. It feels manipulative, like the app is more focused on squeezing money out of users than actually providing value. There are plenty of other apps out there that offer similar or better features for free or at a much more reasonable price, so there’s really no reason to waste time with this one. Overall, it’s frustrating, misleading, and not worth downloading unless you’re willing to pay for something that should have been free in the first place.
